name: PENTA
recent: 公司于2026年11月5日发布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩，营收同比增长54.6%，净利润同比增长76.2%。同期，多家主要股东（EPF、Prudential、KWAP）连续多日申报持股变动。新闻方面，9M26税后利润同比增长39.1%至8560万令吉，但业绩低于部分市场预期。
notable: 截至2026年9月30日季度营收2.240亿令吉，净利润2046万令吉，营收同比增54.6%，净利润同比增76.2%。
9M26税后利润同比增长39.1%至8560万令吉。
主要股东EPF、Prudential及KWAP于11月多日申报持股变动。
risks: 季度净利率由上一季度的10.5%降至9.1%。
新闻标题显示业绩低于市场预期。
earnings: 截至2026年9月30日季度营收2.240亿令吉，环比增23.9%，同比增54.6%；净利润2046万令吉，环比增7.5%，同比增76.2%；净利率9.1%，低于上一季度的10.5%。

recent_en: The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 5 November 2026, with revenue up 54.6% year-on-year and net profit up 76.2% year-on-year. Meanwhile, several major shareholders (EPF, Prudential, KWAP) filed continuous changes in their shareholdings over multiple days. In the news, 9M26 PAT rose 39.1% year-on-year to RM85.6 million, though earnings fell short of some market expectations.
notable_en: Quarterly revenue for the period ended 30 September 2026 was RM224.0 million with net profit of RM20.5 million; revenue up 54.6% YoY and net profit up 76.2% YoY.
9M26 PAT rose 39.1% YoY to RM85.6 million.
Major shareholders EPF, Prudential and KWAP filed changes in their shareholdings on multiple days in November.
risks_en: Quarterly net margin declined to 9.1% from 10.5% in the previous quarter.
News headlines indicate earnings fell short of market expectations.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM224.0 million, up 23.9% QoQ and 54.6% YoY; net profit was RM20.5 million, up 7.5% QoQ and 76.2% YoY; net margin was 9.1%, down from 10.5% in the previous quarter.
